_DEMO_ROLE: Demo payoff — AUTO-TUNED GNN+IMM tracker on the same tropical storm detections. Second of the auto-tune demo pair. Uses cached detections from tropicalStorm_default + the tuner-generated tracker JSON to show what parameter tuning alone can recover.
_DEMO_PREREQ: Before running this, run: (1) runSingleScenario('tropicalStorm_default') to cache detections, then (2) autoTuneTracker('tropicalStorm_default', 'GNN') to generate config/trackers/autotuned/tropicalStorm_default/GNN_IMM.json. Without those two prior steps, this run will error on a missing tracker file.
_DEMO_NARRATIVE: Same scenario, same detections, same tracker TYPE (GNN+IMM) -- only the tracker JSON parameters (gate, volume, beta, IMM filter noise) are different. Any performance delta in compareTrackers is attributable entirely to parameter tuning, not to a different algorithm.
description: TROPICAL STORM (auto-tuned): same scenario as tropicalStorm_default, but GNN+IMM with parameters tuned by autoTuneTracker. Expect notably tighter posRMS, fewer swaps, fewer broken tracks.
